Frequently Asked Questions

I can typically begin work within 24-48 hours of project confirmation and initial payment. For urgent projects, I may be able to start immediately depending on my current workload.

For most projects, I require a 50% upfront payment to begin work, with the remaining 50% due upon completion. For larger projects, we can establish a milestone-based payment schedule. I accept payments through various platforms including bank transfers and online payment gateways.

Yes, I offer ongoing maintenance packages for websites and digital assets. These can be tailored to your specific needs, whether you require regular updates, content changes, or technical support. We can discuss the details based on your requirements.

I'm flexible with communication methods and can adapt to your preferences. This can include email, WhatsApp, Zoom calls, or any other platform you're comfortable with. I provide regular updates throughout the project and am always available to answer questions or address concerns.

Where I Work From

I'm based in Nigeria but provide remote services to clients worldwide. My virtual office is open 24/7, allowing me to serve clients across different time zones.

While I primarily work remotely, I'm open to on-site collaborations for local clients or virtual meetings for international clients.
